content: Screen Wake Lock API (MDN): navigator.wakeLock.request('screen') returns a Promise<WakeLockSentinel>; sentinel has release() method and 'release' event; lock auto-releases when document becomes hidden; standard re-acquire pattern listens for visibilitychange and re-requests when document.visibilityState === 'visible'. No native jsdom support -- must stub navigator.wakeLock manually with vi.stubGlobal or Object.defineProperty(navigator,'wakeLock',...) mocking request() to resolve a fake sentinel (EventTarget-like) with a spy release().
